audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows contradict their own reasons. Level 1 was marked Cassiopeia while whys[0] and spikes[0] both call it even; Levels 4-5 was Skill while whys[3] says Miasma denies every gap-close and the stun is worthless; first item was Skill while whys[5] calls Liandry's or Malignance her peak that melts you before you land a combo.
audit.why: The packet levelChart reads Skill / Cassiopeia x5 / Jax. At 49.68% over 467 games this is a lane Jax survives rather than wins, with an even level 1 and a two-item claw-back.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2 through first item Cassiopeia.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.late name Jax's ult 'Grandmaster’s Might', and the level-6 row credits Jax's stats on a row owned by Cassiopeia.
audit.why: The content layer and mirror both use Grandmaster at Arms, and content is explicit that his resists alone do not beat Petrifying Gaze (120s at rank 1) plus Twin Fang spam.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster at Arms (110s at rank 1). Her spikes: Miasma at 2, Twin Fang ranks, Petrifying Gaze at 6, Liandry's. His: two items, where resists survive one full poison rotation.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phase reasons are shared boilerplate that never state the one mechanic that defines this lane, and they claim Counter Strike 'flips every AA exchange'.
audit.why: Miasma (W, 24s at rank 1) grounds. Both of Jax's mobility tools are dash-flagged, so inside the cloud Leap Strike is unavailable and there is no gap-close at all. Counter Strike dodges attacks only — Noxious Blast, Twin Fang and Petrifying Gaze all land on a Jax standing in E, and she barely autos, so E has almost nothing to catch.
audit.corrected: Miasma grounds for its duration and is 24s at rank 1 — walk that cooldown down instead of leaping into the cloud. Hold Counter Strike for her Twin Fang auto-weave and her step-up for the Gaze, not for poke ticks.
sources: ownerKit Q/W dash flags, E text

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Cassiopeia as 'he'/'his' in tldr, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[2].t, report[9].t, breakdown.feeding and breakdown.late.
The flagged suspectName is a false positive.
audit.why: "Counter Strike's" is the real name with a possessive.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Cassiopeia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Even start: she has only Noxious Blast and no Miasma to ground your leap, and neither side has a kill threat.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Cassiopeia's Miasma is down.
edits.after: Miasma at 2 grounds your Leap Strike the instant you engage, and E dodges autos, not her spells.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Cassiopeia must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Ranking Twin Fang she refunds it on the poisoned target and never feeds an auto into your stun — your combo can't reach.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Miasma's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her poison chips while Miasma denies every gap-close — the Counter Strike stun is worthless if Leap Strike cannot land.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Cassiopeia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze face-stuns you out of any all-in and Twin Fang kills you through it — R's resists alone do not beat that.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Miasma's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's is her peak — the poison out-damages your Trinity Force before you land a combo.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Cassiopeia carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on you can eat one poison rotation, but she scales harder — split and force the 1v1, never group and chase.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then counter-stun his Miasma and out-duel from there.
edits.after: She kites you out — Miasma grounds your leap, so survive and duel her at two items.

edits.before: Counter-stun his Miasma and out-duel from there. Track Miasma before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Bait Miasma (24s at rank 1) — grounded, your Leap Strike is dead. Survive to two items, then duel her side-lane.

edits.before: His early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Hers early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.

edits.before: Hold E until Cassiopeia commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Hold E for her Twin Fang auto-weave and her step-up for the Gaze, not for Noxious Blast poke ticks.

edits.before: That is Cassiopeia's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 — walk that cooldown down rather than leaping into the cloud.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Cassiopeia carry threat: 9/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Grandmaster at Arms stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Cassiopeia carry threat: 9/10 — shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

notes: Three chart rows flipped as one atomic full/content group. The '2+ items' row was deliberately NOT touched: the packet levelChart gives it to Jax and whys[6]/content.late agree, but full.phases[6], content.win[6] and content.spikes[3] all give it to Cassiopeia, and the mirror audit hit the identical contradiction and also declined to guess. Flipping it here would put my side out of step with an un-flipped mirror. See questionsForUser. Both this page and the mirror also confirm: Counter Strike dodges attacks only, so nothing in Cassiopeia's kit is blanked by it.
